set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- A fresh JVM and Scala.js project resolves locally published core and laws candidates.
- The project implements the public adapter without private package access.
- Every public RuleSet executes with meaningful generated inputs and deterministic replay settings.
- POM dependency scopes expose the intended MUnit, ScalaCheck, and Discipline dependencies only.
- Binary and source compatibility policy for the adapter and RuleSets is documented.
- The laws artifact remains experimental until this proof is green.
set.title: Prove the public laws kit in a fresh downstream project
